scope: Windows 10 source-launcher window visibility; development behavior, not native sandbox acceptance
cause: The launcher passed windowsHide:true to Electron as well as the build process. Windows hid Electron's first GUI window even after BrowserWindow.show().

fix.behavior: Keep build windows hidden and explicitly launch the interactive Electron process with windowsHide:false.

recovery.action: The exact hidden normal-client process tree was terminated after its ordinary close signal did not exit. No active work or model requests existed. The same user profile was reopened without deleting data.

boundaries.full_regression_note: This follow-up ran launcher regression and the normal CMD entry. Earlier full-suite and main-thread reports retain their original source scope.
